Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual is a positive exact multiple of the item size, leaving room for a whole number of identical items. This changes ranking only when such multiples exist, which may be rare, and it may overvalue roomy bins that merely happen to align.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r - item > 0 and (r - item) % item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
